correctness.rationale: The indicator has support on the 44 fixed-point-free permutations; at a Walsh frequency its coefficient equals the ordinary integer permanent of the ±1 hollow 5×5 matrix. The 20 allowed off-diagonal cells form the connected bipartite support K5,5 minus its diagonal, with ten nodes and spanning tree of nine edges specified in RESULT.md. Row/column sign gauge fixes those nine signs (one global redundancy), leaving 11 free signs and hence 2048 normalized signings; each class has exactly 2^9 signings, with 2^5 extra inert diagonal frequency bits. Independently evaluated all 2048 signed derangement-monomial permanents and reproduced normalized |W| histogram 0:338,2:504,4:405,6:260,8:130,10:240,12:90,16:60,22:20,44:1. Independently performed a complete 2^20 integer Walsh transform on all 44 binary derangement matrices, reproducing the same histogram multiplied by512 (sum abs5,197,824), hence full 25-bit multiplicities by factor32. Exact zero count 338*2^14=5,537,792, rank28,016,640, min nonzero 2, pseudoinverse norm1/2, normalized 2048-case average |H|=1269/256 and zero probability338/2048=169/1024. Endpoint norms for Fourier projection onto the 44 derangement frequencies equal the kernel L1 norm; no unsupported claim of norm minimality among all projections is made for this record.
